# action.docker_system_prune

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: action. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Removes unused Docker objects, like `docker system prune`, and reports the space reclaimed. By default it removes stopped containers, unused networks, dangling images and build cache; volumes only when `volumes = true`. It acts on every object on the daemon that matches, not only on objects Terraform manages, so narrow it with `filters`.

Actions need Terraform >= 1.14. They keep no state: they run when a
resource's `lifecycle { action_trigger { ... } }` fires, or on demand with
`terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_system_prune.<name>`. Arguments go inside
the action's `config` block.

## Usage

```terraform
action "docker_system_prune" "<name>" {
  config {
    # arguments below
  }
}

# Run it: lifecycle { action_trigger { events = [after_create] actions = [action.docker_system_prune.<name>] } }
# on a resource, or: terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_system_prune.<name>
```

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `all_images` | `bool` | optional |  |  | With `images`, remove every image no container uses, not only dangling ones, and all build cache (`docker system prune -a`). Default `false`. |
| `build_cache` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Remove build cache. Default `true`. The daemon ignores label filters for build cache, so `label`/`label!` filters require `build_cache = false`. |
| `containers` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Remove stopped containers. Default `true`. |
| `filters` | `map(string)` | optional |  |  | Prune filters, one value per key: `until` (e.g. `24h` or a timestamp; not applied to volumes), `label` (`key` or `key=value`) and `label!` (the negation). |
| `images` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Remove dangling images. Default `true`. |
| `networks` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Remove networks no container uses. Default `true`. |
| `volumes` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Remove anonymous volumes no container uses. Default `false`. |

## Example

```terraform
resource "docker_image" "app" {
  name = "nginx:1.27"

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.docker_system_prune.old]
    }
  }
}

# Removes unused objects older than a day after each image change. On demand:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_system_prune.old
action "docker_system_prune" "old" {
  config {
    containers  = true
    images      = true
    networks    = true
    volumes     = false
    build_cache = true
    filters     = { until = "24h" }
  }
}
```
